hero.title: Driven red-legged partridge shooting in Spain
hero.subtitle: Shoot at Villamanrique, Campos de Montiel. Driven days, walked-up shooting, call hunting and releases, with a Bungalow Suite and dining on the estate.

intro: La Calerilla is the shoot of Finca Los Collados de San Miguel, in Villamanrique (Ciudad Real). Red-legged partridge (Alectoris rufa) hold in scrub, olive groves and cereal. Days are organised by Alectoris Ibérica SL.

modalities.title: Driven partridge
modalities.text: Minimum 6 pegs. Bags of 250, 400 or 600 birds, three shots per partridge. Team peg or individual peg.

modalities.title: Walked-up shooting
modalities.text: Six head per gun, rabbit or partridge, at the pace of the ground.

modalities.title: Call hunting
modalities.text: A cock-call day, without lodging or the field snack. Season as set in the Castilla-La Mancha shooting order.

modalities.title: Releases
modalities.text: Minimum 100 birds. The field snack is included.

ojeoTitle: Driven days: included and à la carte
ojeoIncludes: 10 birds per peg (can be delivered plucked)
Bungalow Suite on a bed-and-breakfast basis
reserveNote: A hunting booking is confirmed with a 50 % deposit.
seasonItems: Cock-call: 10 January to 20 February 2027 below 800 m, or 23 January to 5 March 2027 in the other bands of the shooting order.
TODO_DATO: which altitude band applies to Villamanrique.

cta.title: Request the shooting dossier
cta.text: Give dates, number of pegs or guns, and whether you want to stay. No published rates: the dossier is sent on request.

form.title: Request a dossier
form.intro: Preferred dates, number of guns and whether you want a Bungalow Suite or dining. In-season dates should be requested early.

jornada.loopDescription: A loop of a driven day at La Calerilla: holm oaks, beaters and coveys of red-legged partridge.
